summary: Story roll-up for poc-responsiveness. The governed boundary is unchanged and the new surfaces do not widen it: the freshness route carries no governed value - only when data was loaded - and sits behind AuthGuard with no action grant by deliberate choice, since the shell chrome renders for every authenticated user. The retry cannot mask a refusal: absent, malformed and mark_unsupported outcomes were collapsed into one result and are now distinguished before any retry decision, and a second tool-less response answers backend_error rather than not_supported, which would assert a falsehood. Ingress limits on priorTurns are enforced before serialization, and the client trims to the same shared constants - which closed a live defect where the ninth question in a conversation returned 400. Cancellation is bounded and honestly labelled: the model call and stream stop, while a running query expires under statement_timeout, stated at the seam so it is not later mistaken for full cancellation.
